# HexPiece 3.1.7

The Gura ultimate (Island Breaker) is now on **N**, just one more fruit move key next to Z, X, C, V and B. The separate End key from
3.1.6 is gone. Nothing else about the move changed: hold N to charge it fully, let go to break the ground. The abilities panel shows it on
N, and N can be rebound in Controls ("Fruit move N"). Not tested in game yet; the build and tests pass.
